verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a physical data-center GPU, and subscribing to events through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a SaaS/API capability outside this product category, so a buyer comparing GPUs would not reasonably ask it. Nothing in the evidence shows the H200 itself shipping webhooks; the surrounding software ecosystem (CUDA, Brev, NIM) is a separate product and does not make this axis apply.
